items.source: Lazily tries to start the resources on demand if not initialized yet.
items.translation: 如果尚未初始化，则懒式地按需启动资源。

items.source: supplier - the supplier to use
items.translation: supplier - 要使用的供应商

items.source: Note that after a SmartLifecycle stop/restart, new instances of the configured LoopResources and ConnectionProvider are created, so any references to those should be updated. However, this factory does not participate in pause scenarios.
items.translation: 注意，在 `SmartLifecycle` 停止/重启后，会创建新配置的LoopResources和ConnectionProvider实例，因此应更新对这些的引用。然而，此工厂不参与暂停场景。

items.source: Note that this supplier is ignored if isUseGlobalResources() is true or once the ConnectionProvider is set.
items.translation: 请注意，如果isUseGlobalResources()为true，或者一旦设置了ConnectionProvider，则忽略此供应者。

items.source: Note that this supplier is ignored if isUseGlobalResources() is true or once the LoopResources is set.
items.translation: 请注意，如果isUseGlobalResources()为true，或者一旦设置了LoopResources，则忽略此供应者。

items.source: This factory implements SmartLifecycle and is expected typically to be declared as a Spring-managed bean.
items.translation: 该工厂实现了SmartLifecycle，通常预期声明为 Spring 管理的 Bean。

items.source: By default, this is set to LoopResources.DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_QUIET_PERIOD which is 2 seconds but can also be overridden with the system property ReactorNetty.SHUTDOWN_QUIET_PERIOD.
items.translation: 默认情况下，该值设置为 `LoopResources.DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_QUIET_PERIOD`（即 2 秒），但也可以通过系统属性 `ReactorNetty.SHUTDOWN_QUIET_PERIOD` 进行覆盖。

items.source: By default, this is set to LoopResources.DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT which is 15 seconds but can also be overridden with the system property ReactorNetty.SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT.
items.translation: 默认情况下，该值设置为 `LoopResources.DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT`（即 15 秒），但也可以通过系统属性 `ReactorNetty.SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT` 进行覆盖。

items.source: Default is "true" in which case this factory initializes and stops the global Reactor Netty resources within Spring's ApplicationContext lifecycle. If set to "false" the factory manages its resources independent of the global ones.
items.translation: 默认为"true"，此时该工厂会在 Spring 的 `ApplicationContext` 生命周期内初始化并停止全局 Reactor Netty 资源。如果设置为"false"，则该工厂独立于全局资源管理其自身资源。

items.source: By default, ConnectionProvider.elastic("http") is used.
items.translation: 默认情况下，使用ConnectionProvider.elastic("http")。

items.source: By default, LoopResources.create("webflux-http") is used.
items.translation: 默认情况下，使用LoopResources.create("webflux-http")。

items.source: Setting an ApplicationContext is optional: If set, Reactor resources will be initialized in the lifecycle start phase and closed in the lifecycle stop phase. If not set, it will happen in afterPropertiesSet() and destroy(), respectively.
items.translation: 设置 `ApplicationContext` 是可选的：如果设置了，Reactor 资源将在 lifecycle start 阶段初始化，并在 lifecycle stop 阶段关闭。如果未设置，则分别在 afterPropertiesSet() 和 destroy() 中进行。

items.source: Setting an ApplicationContext is optional: If set, Reactor resources will be initialized in the lifecycle start phase and closed in the lifecycle stop phase.
items.translation: 设置 `ApplicationContext` 是可选的：如果设置了，Reactor 资源将在 lifecycle start 阶段初始化，并在 lifecycle stop 阶段关闭。

items.source: Returns false to indicate that a ReactorResourceFactory should be skipped in a pause scenario.
items.translation: 返回false以指示在暂停场景中应跳过ReactorResourceFactory。

items.source: Add a Consumer for configuring the global Reactor Netty resources on startup. When this option is used, setUseGlobalResources(boolean) is also enabled.
items.translation: 添加一个 Consumer 用于在启动时配置全局 Reactor Netty 资源。当使用此选项时，setUseGlobalResources(boolean) 也会被启用。

items.source: Starts the resources if initialized outside an ApplicationContext. This is for backwards compatibility; the preferred way is to rely on the ApplicationContext's lifecycle management.
items.translation: 在 ApplicationContext 外部初始化资源时启动它们。这是为了向后兼容；首选的方式是依赖 ApplicationContext 的生命周期管理。

items.source: Stops the resources if initialized outside an ApplicationContext. This is for backwards compatibility; the preferred way is to rely on the ApplicationContext's lifecycle management.
items.translation: 如果在 ApplicationContext 之外初始化资源，则停止这些资源。这是为了向后兼容；首选的方式是依赖 ApplicationContext 的生命周期管理。

items.source: Whether this factory exposes the global HttpResources holder.
items.translation: 该工厂是否暴露了全局的 HttpResources 持有者。

items.translation: 在使用此方法时，您希望提供一个外部管理的 ConnectionProvider 实例。

items.source: The default implementation returns SmartLifecycle.DEFAULT_PHASE in order to let stop() callbacks execute before regular Lifecycle implementations.
items.translation: 默认实现返回SmartLifecycle.DEFAULT_PHASE，以便在常规`Lifecycle`实现之前执行stop()回调。

items.source: In the case of a container, this will return true only if all components that apply are currently running.
items.translation: 对于容器而言，仅当所有适用的组件当前都在运行时，此方法才返回 `true`。

items.source: Note that this stop notification is not guaranteed to come before destruction: On regular shutdown, Lifecycle beans will first receive a stop notification before the general destruction callbacks are being propagated; however, on hot refresh during a context's lifetime or on aborted refresh attempts, a given bean's destroy method will be called without any consideration of stop signals upfront.
items.translation: 请注意，此停止通知并不保证在销毁之前发出： 在常规关闭过程中，Lifecycle 圈会先接收停止通知，然后再传播通用的销毁回调；然而，在上下文生命周期期间的热刷新或中止的刷新尝试中，给定 bean 的销毁方法将在不考虑任何预先停止信号的情况下被调用。

items.source: Should not throw an exception if the component is already running.
items.translation: 如果组件已经在运行，则不应抛出异常。

items.source:
In the case of a container, this will propagate a hard start signal to all
components that apply, even to non-auto-startup components.
items.translation: 对于容器而言，这将向所有适用的组件传播硬启动信号，即使包括非自动启动的组件。

items.source: Should not throw an exception if the component is not running (not started yet).
items.translation: 如果组件尚未运行（尚未启动），则不应抛出异常。

items.source:
In the case of a container, this will propagate the stop signal to all components
that apply.
items.translation: 对于容器，这将向所有适用的组件传播停止信号。
